papers.title: Busbar Protection Engineering
papers.summary: Compares low-impedance and high-impedance busbar protection schemes, with emphasis on CT performance, stability during external faults, scheme selection, and engineering checks for grid-station design.

papers.title: Condition-Based Maintenance for Grid Stations
papers.summary: How utilities and industrial owners can move from calendar-based maintenance to risk-based condition maintenance across transformers, switchgear, protection systems, batteries, and auxiliary equipment.

papers.title: Digital Substation Process Bus
papers.summary: Bay-level process bus engineering: merging units, sampled values, GOOSE-based trip distribution, time synchronization, redundancy, testing philosophy, and retrofit constraints.

papers.title: IEC 61850 for Grid Stations
papers.summary: Engineering IEC 61850 for new and retrofit grid stations: station-bus philosophy, logical node allocation, interoperability, cyber and timing considerations, and migration sequencing.

papers.title: CT, VT, and CVT Selection for Grid Stations
papers.summary: Instrument transformer application in grid stations: CT class selection, VT and CVT considerations, burden calculations, saturation limits, transient performance, and scheme suitability.

papers.title: Air-Core Series Reactors for MV Short-Circuit Duty
papers.summary: Engineering approach for evaluating air-core single-phase series reactors to reduce prospective short-circuit duty on medium-voltage switchgear, based on IEC-oriented analysis.

papers.title: Substation Arc-Flash Mitigation
papers.summary: Engineering methods to reduce arc-flash exposure in substations and industrial switchgear: protection speed, arc-resistant equipment strategy, remote operation, and zonal interlocking.

papers.title: Substation Upgrade and Retrofit Engineering
papers.summary: Practical brownfield substation upgrades: relay retrofit, control replacement, switchgear retention decisions, outage planning, and fault-level constraints.

papers.title: Teleprotection and Utility Communications
papers.summary: Engineering utility communication channels for line protection and transfer-trip functions: path selection, latency, redundancy, and migration from legacy to packet-based networks.

papers.title: Transformer Online Condition Monitoring
papers.summary: Engineering transformer monitoring beyond isolated sensors by combining DGA, bushings, OLTC, loading, thermal models, and maintenance workflows into a practical asset-health program.

papers.title: Power Transformer Protection Philosophy
papers.summary: How a complete transformer protection philosophy should be structured across primary, backup, and abnormal-condition functions for grid stations and industrial substations.
